protocol.title: Options order-flow toxicity -> subsequent realized volatility: wrapper-free rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on real 7d BTC+ETH captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-62/EVAL-64 (identical causal toxicity signal + spot series via sealed build_states; feasible floor reused verbatim from EVAL-64; no P&L, no wrapper)
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the information-content follow-up that disambiguates EVAL-62/64 NO-GO (null signal vs. wrapper cost)
protocol.signal: signal_z_k = expanding-zscore of per-bar options order-flow toxicity (tox) / signed-aggressor imbalance (imbalance), reused verbatim from EVAL-61/EVAL-62 (causal, end-of-bar k)
protocol.target: rv_{k+1..k+H} = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp 1m/5m bars (forward realized vol, strictly after the decision at k)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, rv_forward_k)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses the already-acquired real 7d captures; no new acquisition, no network; the feasible floor is reused verbatim from sealed EVAL-64

floor.note: order-flow span floor is a heavier-than-EVAL-62 24h bar because Deribit tick-trade retention is ~24h; surface/perp floors require the full >=7d
